topic: What is Elucera? Turn any question into a captioned 60-second animated explainer reel
narration: Got a question? Get a sixty second cartoon back.
description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Center-frame rounded phone frame (white border, dark fill) occupying middle 35-75% height, glowing Lucide CircleHelp question mark in accent cyan centered inside. Bold kinetic captions in fg white middle-band pop with scale punch: 'Got a question?' then '60 SECOND CARTOON' in accent2 magenta and accent3 yellow. Play triangle icon morphs in over question mark. Camera zoom pulse 105% on beat. No elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Phone frame snaps in center with glowing cyan question mark; word Got pops large white center-middle.
Word question? pops accent cyan beside Got; question mark icon pulses glow and shakes.
Question mark morphs to white play button in magenta circle; words sixty second slam in accent2 below.
Word cartoon pops accent3 yellow large; cartoon sun doodle bursts behind play button; camera zoom pulses in.
Word back. pops white; phone frame bounces and glows, holding hero pose.
